text:
Situation: Fluorouracil 50 mg/mL 20 mL vials are not on the FDA drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 52 vials (18.3 days on hand at 2.8 vials per day). Corvale General holds 56 vials (20.3 days on hand at 2.8 vials per day).

Why (FDA record): FDA records show fluorouracil is not listed on the drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Current inventory covers approximately three weeks at both sites. No FDA shortage declaration exists. Procurement should proceed to secure supply before stock falls below a two-week threshold.

Recommended actions:
1. Place orders with Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC (plant last inspected VAI 2023-08-24) — approved by pharmacy buyer and P&T committee chair.
2. Qualify Heritage Pharmaceuticals Inc. d/b/a Avet Pharmaceuticals Inc. (supplied from Gland Pharma Limited) as a secondary source — approved by pharmacy buyer and quality assurance manager.
3. Defer Accord Healthcare, Inc. (supplied from Intas Pharmaceuticals Ltd, plant last inspected OAI 2022-12-02) pending quality review — approved by pharmacy buyer and quality assurance director.
4. Request manufacturing site details for Alembic Pharmaceuticals Inc. and Alembic Pharmaceuticals Limited before consideration — approved by pharmacy buyer and regulatory affairs.

Not recommended: No clinical protocol changes or allocation restrictions at this time.
